solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: What can hold together masseur and pop group?

parts.note: a masseur rubs people, so is a rubber
a pop group is a band

explanation.surface: A riddle asking what might unite a massage therapist and a group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Masseur' reads as a person in a story, but here it is just one who rubs: a rubber.
explanation.definitionFit: An elastic loop is used to keep loose items bundled together.

clue.text: Trivial yet extraordinary subject of theory

indicators.note: extraordinary means out of the ordinary order, so the letters of trivial yet are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dismissive remark that some theory's topic is both trivial and remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extraordinary' rearranges the ten letters of TRIVIAL YET.
explanation.definitionFit: Einstein's famous theory is the theory of relativity, so this is its subject.

clue.text: Large rock overturned

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue means the word for rock is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: Gib is short for Gibraltar, known as the Rock

explanation.surface: A big boulder has been tipped over.
explanation.walkthrough: Gibraltar, the British territory at the tip of Spain, is called the Rock, shortened to Gib.
explanation.definitionFit: Big and large are plain synonyms describing considerable size.

clue.text: Key copier, one getting away?

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard
an aper is one who apes, or copies

explanation.surface: A person who copies keys is perhaps on the run.
explanation.definitionFit: An escaper is someone who flees from captivity or confinement.

clue.text: Groom partner to keep going finally in tricky game

indicators.note: to keep means the bride's word holds the extra letter inside it

parts.note: a groom's partner at a wedding is the bride

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of going

explanation.surface: A groom's partner needs to persevere at a difficult game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To keep' puts G, the last letter of 'going', inside BRIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridge is a card game for four players, known for complex bidding.

clue.text: Labourer against entering one of the armed forces

indicators.note: entering means the letter for against goes into the service's name

parts.note: the navy is one of the armed forces
V, short for versus, means against

explanation.surface: A worker opposed to joining the military.
explanation.definitionFit: A navvy is a British term for a manual worker on roads, railways or canals.

clue.text: Bundle of tissue in giant elm tangled

indicators.note: tangled means twisted up, so the letters of giant elm are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some fibrous material is caught up in a large elm tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tangled' rearranges the letters of GIANT ELM.
explanation.definitionFit: A ligament is a band of fibrous connective tissue joining bones.

clue.text: Look at American soldier with cold reason

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
a GI is an American soldier
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A US soldier is observed using clear thinking despite the chill.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic is the faculty of sound reasoning, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Opening pub is very fine, but to no purpose

indicators.note: opening means the following letters prise the pub's word open and sit inside

parts.note: a pub is an inn
A1 means first-rate or fine, written here as AI

explanation.surface: A newly opened pub is excellent, but it is all for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: AI stands for A1, meaning first-rate; 'Opening' tells the solver the pub word is split to take letters inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in vain means doing it without success or result.

clue.text: A platform for rolling fish on table

parts.note: a skate is a flat fish
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A fish dish being served on a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A skateboard is a short deck on wheels that a rider stands on.

clue.text: Twitch seen regularly

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of twitch, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A nervous twitch that keeps recurring.
explanation.walkthrough: The odd letters of TwItCh give the answer, and a tic is a twitch seen again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: A tic is a habitual spasm of the muscles, recurring involuntarily.

clue.text: Make random selection from actors, great numbers

parts.note: the actors in a play are its cast
lots means great numbers

explanation.surface: Choosing performers at random from a large crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Casting lots is drawing straws or similar to decide something by chance.

clue.text: Greedy to rely on kid's savings here

parts.note: piggy means greedy, like a pig
to bank on something is to rely on it

explanation.surface: A greedy child counting on their savings.
explanation.definitionFit: A piggy bank is a pig-shaped money box in which a child keeps coins.

clue.text: Church room exceptionally entered by short street

indicators.note: entered by means the street abbreviation goes inside the word for exceptionally

parts.note: exceptionally means very
St is the short form of street

explanation.surface: A church room is unusually reached from a little lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exceptionally' is not an anagram signal here; it simply means VERY.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestry is a room in a church where clergy robe and vestments are kept.

clue.text: Pathetic sailor caught in a stream

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: in means the cricket letter for caught sits inside the stream word

parts.note: a jet is a stream of liquid
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A sorry sailor is swept up in a current.
explanation.definitionFit: Abject describes a wretched, miserable state, much as pathetic does.

clue.text: One made from flour, or flower

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a large loaf of bread
second meaning: a flower is something that blooms

explanation.walkthrough: Flour and flower sound alike, but each word just points to one sense: a British loaf and something that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloomer is a British crusty loaf, and literally a plant that comes into bloom.

clue.text: Raise an attempted robbery

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a robbery, often at gunpoint

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase works as a verb for lifting and as a noun for a raid.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold up means to lift aloft, and a hold-up is an armed raid on a bank or shop.

clue.text: With this lens, capture elephant (not ant!) in toto?

indicators.note: in means the shortened animal goes inside toto
not ant means the letters a, n, t are taken out of elephant

explanation.surface: A photographer's instruction to snap an entire elephant, ant excluded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In toto' looks like the Latin phrase for 'entirely', but toto is simply the word to put letters inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A telephoto lens lets photographers shoot distant subjects, magnified.

clue.text: Harmless sort of tiger may be decorative on the wall

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a ... tiger is a threat with no real power

definitions.text: may be decorative on the wall
definitions.meaning: second meaning: wallpaper is ... hung on walls

explanation.walkthrough: A paper tiger looks fierce but is harmless; wallpaper decorates a room.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper names both an empty threat, a paper tiger, and the sheets used for decorating walls.

clue.text: Flap as night flyer returns

indicators.note: returns means the word for the flyer is read backwards

parts.note: a bat flies at night

explanation.surface: Something flaps as a nocturnal creature comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: A tab is a small projecting flap of material, as on a file or a can.

clue.text: Good man raised idea, half foolish

parts.note: St, saint, is a good man
up means raised

indicators.note: half keeps only the first two of the four letters of idea

explanation.surface: A virtuous man voiced a half-baked notion.
explanation.definitionFit: Stupid and foolish both describe a lack of good sense.

clue.text: One heading for Arctic following sea channels

indicators.note: following means the one and the Arctic letter come after the sea

parts.note: the Med is the Mediterranean Sea
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: heading for takes the first letter of Arctic

explanation.surface: A lone sailor making for the Arctic after crossing the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Media are the channels of mass communication such as TV and press.

clue.text: Welshman losing footing on platform

indicators.note: losing footing means the bottom letter of the platform word, in a down clue, drops off

parts.note: a dais is a raised platform

explanation.surface: A man from Wales slips off a stage.
explanation.walkthrough: Dai is a typical Welsh man's name, used in crosswords for any Welshman.
explanation.definitionFit: Dai, a form of David, is a stock Welsh first name.

clue.text: Landed — correct — then confined

parts.note: proper means correct
tied means confined or restricted

explanation.surface: Someone touches down properly and is then locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Landed' suggests arriving, but here it means owning land.
explanation.definitionFit: Landed gentry are propertied: they own estates.
